fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts or driveway markers on both sides to define the entry point, especially at night or in low visibility.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway edges to maintain a clear path wide enough for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the main residence and detached structure to create a gap between plants and building walls.
• Thin dense vegetation areas to reduce the chance of fire spreading from vegetation to structures.
• Clear a walking path around the perimeter of the main residence so responders can move between the front and rear of the property on foot.
• Keep any gates along walkways or side passages unlocked or marked to allow responders to reach the rear of the property quickly.
• Mark the detached structure with a visible label or number so responders can distinguish it from the main residence during an emergency.
• Keep the parking area clear of stored items so responders have room to stage equipment or position vehicles close to the residence.
• Trim any vegetation or overgrowth that blocks sight lines from the street to the front entrance of the residence.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree clusters near the structures to create open space between the trees and the buildings.
• Remove or trim shrubs and other plants growing directly against the exterior walls of the structures.
• Thin scattered trees across the property to reduce the amount of connected vegetation that could carry fire toward the structures.
• Cut grass regularly across the property, especially in areas close to the structures and driveway.
• Trim tree branches and shrubs growing over or alongside the driveway to keep it clear for vehicle access.
• Thin mixed vegetation areas near the structures by removing the densest plants and creating gaps between remaining plants.
• Scatter and separate shrubs near the structures so no continuous line of shrubs runs toward any building.
• Remove dead branches, leaves, and plant debris from beneath trees near the structures.
• Keep the area under and around tree clusters near the structures clear of low-hanging branches and accumulated debris.
